issues.quote: Then at twenty-one minutes past ten by my watch, someone came quickly down. I did not see who that was either.
issues.fact: F4 places the 10:21 descent after the 10:18 thump, and the 10:15 ascent before it. The fact sheet's sequence is: up at 10:15, thump at 10:18, then down at 10:21.
issues.misreading: In the transcript the 10:21 descent comes before the piano, the thump, and the repeater. A solver could read the sequence as up at 10:15, down at 10:21, then thump at 10:18, which contradicts the watch readings. Because the thump is at 10:18 and the descent at 10:21, the order of these events decides who could have been on the stairs when the thump happened.
